title: Comment on GitHub issues with AI after reviewing the text
h1: write the github issue comment that moves things along
description: Turn a GitHub issue discussion into a useful follow-up question or workaround. Read the proposed comment, then allow the bot to post it for you.
keywords: claude comment on github pull request
answer:
**get the missing detail without writing another follow-up yourself.** the bot reads a github issue or pull request and drafts a markdown comment. paste the discussion link so it lands in the right repository.

comments count as sends. they ask by default, and you can set a daily amount for the bot.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: the right comment on the right issue.
what:
**a good question gets the reporter unstuck.** paste the issue or pull request link. it gives the bot the account, repository and number. have it read the discussion so it asks for what's still missing.

this adds a new discussion comment. editing an old comment and reviewing specific code lines need other actions.

careful with **Full access**: a bot there with no sending rule can send up to 25 a day without asking. give it **Ask every time**.
uses: **ask for the missing step.** review the question before the reporter sees it.
**share a confirmed workaround.** help people waiting on the issue without promising a release.
**follow up on a pull request.** leave a general comment when a line-by-line review is unnecessary.

routine.message:
when a new issue opens in fernwharf-labs/relay, read it and its discussion. if the device model is missing, draft a short question asking for it. show the issue link and question here. post only after i allow it, then confirm here.

never promise a fix date or close the issue. if the reporter already gave the model, stay quiet.
routine.when: when a new issue opens in fernwharf-labs/relay
routine.needs: github read and write for reading and commenting; sending set to **Ask every time**
routine.output:
fernwharf-labs/relay #68

question for lior: which device model has the connection drop?

open the linked issue, read the question, then choose **Allow** or **Deny**.

steps: **allow only the work it needs.** connect github with reading and commenting actions for this bot.
**set the send rule.** choose **Ask every time**.
**start with one issue link.** ask for a comment based on the discussion, with no extra promises.
**read it where it will land.** confirm the repository and question, then choose **Allow**. early event runs appear in **automations**.
watch: **issue numbers repeat across repositories.** use the full link with the owner, repository and issue number.
**people can read what you post.** remove private customer details even if they helped the investigation.
**use a general comment for discussion.** a fix still needs code, and a formal code review needs its own action.
**events arrive at once; sleeping bots cannot act.** local work needs the computer awake and the app open. dusk cloud stays on.

faq.q: can it comment on a pull request too?
faq.a: **yes.** paste its link and ask for a general discussion comment.

faq.q: can every comment wait for me?
faq.a: **yes. set sending to Ask every time.** each comment then comes to you with an approval card.

steps: ask it to read the thread
ask for a question in your dusk chat
confirm the repository before allowing the post

mistakes.mistake: asking it to comment on just #68
mistakes.fix: paste the full link. issue numbers repeat in other repositories.

mistakes.mistake: turning a guess into a release promise
mistakes.fix: ask only for missing facts. keep dates out until someone confirms them.

tip.text: read the last reply before posting. somebody may have answered while you were drafting.
